casual_plan.exampleText: Sketching habitat plants and Pokémon tracks in a notebook on a park bench.

manual.content: A graphite pencil touches the open notebook on the park bench as she sketches the fern fronds and tiny tracks in the soil; late-afternoon sun catches the page.
manual.why: 예시 hobby_sketch에 없는 구체적인 활동·물건·빛을 추가: A graphite pencil touches the open notebook on the park bench as she sketches the fern fronds and tiny tracks in the soil; late-afternoon sun catches the page.

manual.content: A terracotta short-overall romper has a single shoulder strap connected to a slim halter loop, over a fitted ivory bandeau, leaving the opposite shoulder and most of her thighs visible.
manual.why: overalls에 계획된 one-shoulder cut / halter neck 재단과 이 장면의 소재·색을 명시: A terracotta short-overall romper has a single shoulder strap connected to a slim halter loop, over a fitted ivory bandeau, leaving the opposite shoulder and most of her thighs visible.

replan_reason: 첫 casual3에서 스케치 동작이 빠짐. 완료한 casual1·2의 실제 WebP와 UI 기록을 보존하고 계획기의 refill로 3번만 다시 정했다. on_tiptoe·hands_in_hair·walking을 활동 부적합 후보로 제외했고, 최종 계획은 kneeling·side·chest_up이다. 장면 칸에 연필로 스케치하는 구체 동작을 추가했다.
